notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four other creatures that can attack this turn.
An opponent is unable to block and kill your creatures.
description:
Declare Najeela and four other creatures as attackers, attacking an opponent that is unable to block or kill them.
Najeela triggers, creating at least one 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Holding priority, activate Najeela and the four untapped attacking creatures by tapping them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
